:::{#lem-prediction-error-split}
#### Prediction error splits at the conditional mean

Let $\bestpredfnf{\Predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$.
For any prediction function $\predfnf{\Predvar}$:

$$\prederr_{\predfn} = \prederr_{\bestpredfn} + \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}}$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\prederr_{\predfn}
&= \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar
&& \text{(definition of } \prederr_{\predfn} \text{)} \\
&= \paren{\bestpredfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar} + \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(add and subtract } \bestpredfnf{\Predvar} \text{)} \\
&= \prederr_{\bestpredfn} + \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \bestpredfnf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(definition of } \prederr_{\bestpredfn} \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-prediction-error-split}
#### The split in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
when $\Predvar = 0$ and $\Outvar = 0$,
the constant prediction $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$ has prediction error $\prederr_{\predfn_1} = 3$.
The conditional mean is $\bestpredfnf{0} = 1$,
so $\prederr_{\bestpredfn} = 1$ and $\predfn_1\paren{0} - \bestpredfnf{0} = 2$,
and $3 = 1 + 2$.

:::
